scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,be,fe -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mysterytalk/shared" "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w backend
